content:
Aisha: Heads-up team  VeritasPay onboarding starts Monday. High-level asks: get them to a repeatable E2E demo, define renewal signals, confirm data-residency constraints, and hand off enablement. Who's joining from Veritas? :wave:

Leo: Veritas will send PM + 1 infra eng + 1 compliance lead. I'll add them to the invite.

Grace: I'll run enablement (dev + compliance tracks). Plan: 30m API demo, 40m hands-on lab, 20m compliance Q&A. Will deliver a one-pager and recordings.

Tom: I'll own infra & perf. Need staging jumpbox, token profile (burst vs steady), and clarification on at-rest residency. Note: if they require EU-only hosting that's a separate SOW (+2w). Tagging RISK-DATA.

Aisha: Proposed 21-day ramp (light):
Day 0: kickoff + contacts + compliance checklist
Day 1-4: API integration + smoke tests
Day 5-9: perf tuning + batching/quant experiments
Day 10-15: enablement + role-based labs
Day 16-19: feedback sprint + adoption trials
Day 20-21: retro + exec readout / go/no-go

Grace: Success criteria idea: "integration green + 4 demo flows passing with 3 distinct users + 95th pct latency <350ms on 512-token samples + compliance acceptance on data residency appendix." Thoughts?

Leo: +1. Also requesting staging key + residency statement by EOD Wed so we can validate hosting.

Tom: Quick infra note (to share with Veritas): ```scp jumpbox.key user@jumpbox; curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/ping```

onboard-bot: Checklist created: https://redwood.checklists/4187654321  owners: Grace(enablement), Tom(infra), Leo(customer liaison), Aisha(exec). Includes compliance action items and RISK-DATA tag.

Aisha: Daily 15-min stand at 09:00 PST during active days. If anyone sees a blocker, drop it here with RISK-xxx and we'll escalate. Thanks! :thumbsup:
